description.value: Hike-in backcountry lakeside camp deep in E.C. Manning Park's Cascade Mountain wilderness, accessible only on foot (more than 1 km from any road); a permit ($5/person/night) is required and no cellphone service exists in the park.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Strike Lake as a backcountry tent campsite (backcountry=yes, capacity:tents=8) within E.C. Manning Park; the BC Parks website confirms it as one of ten named backcountry campgrounds in the park, all managed by BC Parks. The website explicitly states 'Most backcountry campgrounds in E.C. Manning Park do not accept reservations' and names only Buckhorn, Kicking Horse, and Frosty Creek as the exceptions requiring advance reservations — Strike Lake is not among them, placing it in the permit-only category. No amenity-level details specific to Strike Lake (water, shelter, storage, etc.) are provided on the page, so most optional fields remain null.
concerns: Backcountry location (defined as more than 1 km from any highway or park road) limits accessibility to road touring cyclists; most relevant for bikepackers or those with off-road capability.
No campground-specific address, phone, or contact information available in OSM or on the website; the BC Parks general contact page covers all inquiries.
E.C. Manning Park has no cellphone service; the nearest public phones are at Manning Park Resort on Highway 3.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Strike Lake is a legitimate, currently active BC Parks-managed backcountry campground within E.C. Manning Park; it is a valid overnight option for bikepackers and gravel cyclists exploring the Cascades.
enrichment_extras.notes: Overnight stays require a backcountry permit; registration available at camping.bcparks.ca, by calling 1-800-689-9025 (toll-free Canada/US), or in person at the Manning Park visitor centre, Manning Park Lodge, or Lightning Lake gatehouse. The park website is a shared page covering all ten E.C. Manning backcountry campgrounds, not a dedicated Strike Lake page.

wow_evidence: accessible only on foot (more than 1 km from any road)
